ownership_policy.path_syntax: Exact repository-relative files, or trailing /** for the named task subtree only. No other glob syntax.
ownership_policy.activation: Only P0-001 is active. Other owners require all depends_on tasks DONE, a recorded dispatch checkpoint and a verified task branch/draft PR before writes.
ownership_policy.coordination: Role 00 alone maintains tasks/pilot.json and docs/STATUS.md. Specialists submit checkpoint/PR evidence rather than editing these shared ledgers. P0-020 needs an explicit recorded handoff for ledger updates after P0-001 closes.
ownership_policy.handoff: Role 02 records any shared-path transfer in docs/governance/P0-004-integration.md; role 00 updates registry allocation. No simultaneous writers.
ownership_policy.limits: At most eight changed paths and 1500 source lines per response, including work within reserved subtrees.
ownership_policy.unallocated_paths: Read-only until role 00 records an allocation; a role title does not grant write access.
